podcast.body: "Cherry Bomb" is arguably The Runaways' best-known song. A live version was recorded during their 1977 tour of Japan, highlighting their electrifying performance style and their significant success in that country. "The Runaways, with probably their best known song, Cherry Bomb, recorded live in a tour of Japan in 1977."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
